items.difficulty_reason: Full induction for the stated case: state-pair encoding, base case, step with the inductive hypothesis used explicitly, and the final projection; 75-line proof. The author declares the single-additional-argument simplification (proof lines 1163-1164) with the general case the same construction.

primary.label: author lem environment with its own label lem:prim (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1145-1150

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lem: Encode the iteration state as a pair (current y, current h-value); H = lambda x y. Snd of (y applied to D at (0, F x)) with D the one-step pair update iterates D m times by the Church numeral's iterator property; induction on m shows the m-fold iterate reduces to the pair (m, h(n,m)), and the final Snd projects the value h(n,m). (source lines 1152-1226)
